# ScoutLink

ScoutLink is a football intelligence product operated by Stratex Analytics. It helps grassroots coaches maintain structured U7–U16 player evidence and gives reviewed professional and semi-professional scouts controlled tools to search, compare and shortlist players.

## Canonical public pages
- Homepage: https://www.scoutlink.app/
- Coaches: https://www.scoutlink.app/coaches
- Scouts: https://www.scoutlink.app/scouts
- Demo: https://www.scoutlink.app/demo
- Pricing: https://www.scoutlink.app/scoutlink/pricing
- Login: https://www.scoutlink.app/login
- Register: https://www.scoutlink.app/register
- Coach registration: https://www.scoutlink.app/register/coach
- Scout access application: https://www.scoutlink.app/register/scout
- Safeguarding: https://www.scoutlink.app/safeguarding
- Report a concern: https://www.scoutlink.app/report-a-concern
- Data policy: https://www.scoutlink.app/data-policy
- Privacy policy: https://www.scoutlink.app/privacy-policy
- Terms: https://www.scoutlink.app/terms
- Cookie policy: https://www.scoutlink.app/cookie-policy

## Action-specific routes
Password recovery, account completion, password confirmation, experience selection and tokenised video upload routes are functional account actions. They should not be treated as general public-information pages.

## Removed routes
Routes not included in the canonical public-page list are not alternative ScoutLink pages. They return a not-found response on the ScoutLink domain rather than redirecting elsewhere.

## Private routes
Do not index or summarise logged-in product routes under /coach, /scout, /player, /stratex or /admin.

## Product wording
ScoutLink provides structured evidence and explainable decision support. It does not guarantee a trial, academy place, contract, signing or professional football outcome.
